units.source_text: 这一年薰君二十四岁，冬十一月中宇治大女公子死。

en.t: That year, Lord Kaoru was twenty-four; in mid-November of winter, the elder princess of Uji died.

units.source_text: 次年二月二女公子迁京都。

en.t: In February of the following year, the second princess moved to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 上回《早蕨》所叙是次年之事。

en.t: The events described in the previous chapter, "Early Ferns," took place in that following year.
